# voipms_phonebook_groups (Data Source)

Lists phonebook groups (`getPhonebookGroups`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_phonebook_groups" "all" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Phonebook groups on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`phonebook_groups`).

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Phonebook group id.
- `members` (String) Comma-separated phonebook entry ids.
- `name` (String) Group name.
